What we do

Two service lines. One standard of delivery.

Practical support designed around the needs of Australian professional practices. All work is subject to agreed scope and practitioner review where applicable.

01 / SPECIALIST SUPPORT

Corporate insolvency & restructuring

Casework assistance for insolvency practitioners across formal appointments.

  • CVLs, court liquidations, VAs, SBRs and receiverships
  • Statutory and creditor reporting; ASIC forms
  • Financial investigations and transaction reviews
  • Bank reconciliations, ROCAP and POD reviews
  • Creditor correspondence and file administration

02 / PRACTICE SUPPORT

Accounting & bookkeeping

Ongoing or assignment-based assistance for accounting and bookkeeping firms.

  • Bank and balance-sheet reconciliations
  • Accounts payable and accounts receivable
  • Payroll and superannuation processing support
  • Financial statements and year-end workpapers
  • Audit workpapers and testing assistance

About the founder

Australian experience. A practical approach.

Kumar & Associates was founded by Kapil Kumar, a CPA Australia member and Australian graduate with onshore experience across public practice and industry.

His professional background includes NSW Trustee & Guardian, Wexted Advisors (insolvency) and BDO (audit). That experience informs how the firm approaches deadlines, workpaper quality, practitioner oversight and communication.

  • Corporate insolvency and restructuring experience
  • Australian accounting and audit experience
  • Independent professional services delivery

Frequently asked questions

How the relationship works.

Do you replace our existing team?

No. Kumar & Associates is intended to complement your team with agreed external capacity. Your firm retains its client relationships, decision-making and professional oversight.

Can we engage you for a single insolvency matter?

Yes. We offer assignment-based support for appropriately scoped matters, as well as ongoing dedicated arrangements. Minimum engagements and fees are discussed based on the work.

Will Kapil personally work on our files?

Founder-led technical casework can be arranged subject to Kapil's availability and confirmation of scope before engagement.

Which accounting platforms do you support?

Our accounting service scope includes work in Xero, MYOB and QuickBooks, subject to the systems and access available for the engagement.

How are confidentiality and quality handled?

We agree on access, confidentiality, deliverables, review responsibilities and escalation processes as part of engagement onboarding. Specific security requirements should be discussed before any client files are shared.
